'''Zaloriis''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] colonized by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] it was home to [[Camp Culroon]], a hidden [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] research base. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the planet attempted to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], but [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] led a strike force to [[Zaloriis campaign/Legends|recapture the planet]].

==History==
The high winds of Zaloriis kept life to a minimum, but the sheltering boulders of the [[Fantain Mountains]] harbored smaller creatures and [[Zalorian rock-lion]]s. Legends spoke of dune ghosts that wandered the wastes at night, and of travelers who never returned from their journeys. The natives respected the open deserts and lived well away from them, clustering in small outposts connected by well-traveled roads.<ref name="SW:GB" />

The Imperials recognized the value of the Zalorians' fear and they established a research base out in the desert; Colonel [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] was in charge of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] improvement program on the planet. Their test vehicles often bolstered the legends and tall-tales, as wanderers spotted the strange technologies being tested and reported back exaggerated accounts at the local tavern. One prototype walker was described as a "[[Dune-cow|dune cow]] with giant tusks and a gray reptilian hide."<ref name="SW:GB" />

Before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], it was governed by [[Zalor Minister|Minister]] [[Transe Decar]] when the planet decided to request independence. Vader denied the request and [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|choked]] Minister Decar with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After freeing Veers from a revolt by the [[Zalorian Separatists]], Vader used the AT-AT prototype to [[Zaloriis campaign/Legends|assault]] [[Zaloriis City]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base there.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zaloriis first appeared in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' during the Darth Vader campaign. The campaign was later included in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]. The game's [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]], released a week before the game, was the first source to mention Zaloriis.

''Galactic Battlegrounds'' implied that Zaloriis was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], as Vader was searching for the Rebels there during the campaign. However, the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Zaloriis in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], in grid square P-12.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
